intro.text: You wake up in a quiet laboratory. A locked door stands beside a narrow maintenance vent.

vent.text: A brass key hangs from a forgotten cable. You take it and crawl back to the lab.

drop.text: You leave the key beside the vent. Perhaps you will need it later.

win.text: Fresh air! The exit terminal flashes the password for the encrypted lab disk.

lost.text: The elevator descends into another laboratory. Your escape will have to wait.
